title: The Last Voyage of the Warsaw Queen
author: Charles M Ball

archive.primary: The Last Voyage of the Warsaw Q.gblorb

description:
A parser-based horror adventure game, downloadable or playable on the web, enhanced by some accessory images and assets.

Milford Young was a riverboat gambler on the Mississippi River, who perished in the tragic wreck of the Warsaw Queen, a nineteenth century stern-wheel paddle steamer, on the night of March 25, 1889. He was also your great-great-grandfather. His legend lives large in your family history, but Milford Young had secrets that never made it into any of the stories passed down through the generations...

Content warning: Gambling, drinking, lawlessness, some violence, supernatural horror, death, and vaguely implied sexual situations
